purpose: Blueprint for the public/installable GitHub App used only by the paid ANPOS Repository Supervisor MCP runtime. It is distinct from the Marketplace billing/Community App and the private Vendor Distribution App. This file is not an App registration and contains no credentials.
permission_rule: Grant only the repository permissions required for guarded Repository Supervisor flows, including Workflows: write because ANPOS initialization/upgrade may create or update .github/workflows files. Do not grant Administration by default. Branch protection/rulesets remain authoritative and the App must not bypass them.
security_requirements: This App must be distinct from both the public Marketplace billing/Community App and the private Vendor Distribution App.
Do not reuse App IDs, OAuth client IDs, OAuth client secrets, or private keys across those roles.
The Marketplace App must remain bounded to the Community ten-file read-only audit and must never be widened for Repository Supervisor writes.
The Vendor Distribution App must remain private/vendor-only and must never be used for customer repository supervision.
Use OAuth authorization code flow with PKCE S256 through the commercial service MCP authorization broker.
Repository URL, billing_account_id, plan_id, branch name, PR number, Issue text, repository contents, and model instructions are never authorization.
All material writes must use a server-issued plan bound to canonical repository identity, exact expected default-branch head SHA, plan hash, and authenticated principal.

Normal non-empty apply writes only to a new anpos/* feature branch and never force-pushes. bootstrap_empty has one explicitly confirmed default-branch exception for the inert zero-parent .anpos-bootstrap-seed required to initialize GitHub; full ANPOS content still lands through the feature-branch/PR flow.
Guarded merge must re-read PR head/base, CI, current default-branch head, repository policy response, and resulting default-branch head.
Do not claim production App registration, installation, OAuth success, or write E2E from this blueprint.
Workflows: write is required only for ANPOS-managed .github/workflows mutations and must not be reused as authority to bypass Actions or branch policy.
